name: lemma-compass
description: Lemma Compass — decision skills for Claude. Untangle a situation nobody has framed yet, compare options you already have, stress-test a direction before committing, and record why you decided.

plugins.name: lemma-compass
plugins.description: Turn a messy decision into clear options, the tradeoffs that actually change it, and one next step. No invented scores, no committee of AI personas, no server — four skills and nothing else.
